response.justification: While Bogdan brings solid software engineering fundamentals with 20 years of experience across diverse platforms and meets the minimum qualifications (BS in CS, 15+ years), he significantly lacks the AI/ML expertise expected for a Principal Engineer focused on AI Strategy. With only ~16 months in an AI-related role (re:cinq) and no prior machine learning background, he cannot demonstrate the 'recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms' required to advise customers on cutting-edge AI adoption or serve as a strategic thought leader in the AI domain. His current AI infrastructure work is promising but far too early-stage for this principal-level position.
strengths: 20 years of software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, exceeding the 15-year minimum requirement
Demonstrated technical leadership and knowledge-sharing with organized workshops, public conference talks, and community contributions including open-source projects
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing recent engagement with AI domain technologies
concerns: Critical gap in AI/ML expertise: only ~16 months in AI-focused role with zero prior machine learning or AI background, insufficient for strategic AI leadership
Missing preferred qualifications: holds only BS in Computer Science without Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field
No demonstrated AI products or platforms: lacks the proven track record of building AI-powered solutions expected for advising strategic customers on AI adoption
